{"cards":[{"w":"able","ex":[{"en":"I am able to finish the report by Friday.","zh":"我週五前能夠完成報告。"},{"en":"Are you able to join us for dinner tonight?","zh":"你今晚能來跟我們一起吃晚餐嗎？"}],"hook":"","confuse":["enable","disable"]},{"w":"review","ex":[{"en":"We will review the vocabulary before the test.","zh":"我們考試前會複習單字。"},{"en":"The manager asked us to review the proposal carefully.","zh":"經理要我們仔細檢討這份提案。"}],"hook":"re- 再 + view 看，再看一次就是複習","confuse":["preview","interview"]},{"w":"abandon","ex":[{"en":"They abandoned the old car on the side of the road.","zh":"他們把那輛舊車丟在路邊。"},{"en":"Never abandon your dreams, even when things get hard.","zh":"即使事情變得困難，也不要放棄你的夢想。"}],"hook":"","confuse":["abundant","abound"]},{"w":"opt","ex":[{"en":"Students can opt for either English or French class.","zh":"學生可以選擇英文課或法文課。"},{"en":"I opted to take the train instead of driving.","zh":"我選擇搭火車，而不是開車。"}],"hook":"opt 是 option（選項）的字根，選了就是做選擇","confuse":["adopt","option"]},{"w":"reluctant","ex":[{"en":"She was reluctant to admit that she had made a mistake.","zh":"她不太願意承認自己犯了錯。"},{"en":"He is reluctant to speak in front of large crowds.","zh":"他不太願意在大群人面前講話。"}],"hook":"源自拉丁文 reluctari「抗拒」，luct 有掙扎、抗拒之意","confuse":["reliant","reliable"]},{"w":"ambiguous","ex":[{"en":"The instructions were ambiguous, so we asked the teacher.","zh":"這份說明模稜兩可，所以我們去問老師。"},{"en":"His answer was ambiguous, and nobody understood what he meant.","zh":"他的回答含糊不清，沒人聽懂他的意思。"}],"hook":"ambi- 兩、雙（如 ambidextrous 雙手都靈活）＋ 有兩種解讀","confuse":["ambivalent","ambitious"]}]}
